title: Horsemeat cutlets

media.caption: Lay the slices of horsemeat on a cutting board and on top of the meat place: the garlic, parsley, pecorino cheese, salt and, if desired, a little chili or pepper.
Continue arranging the garlic, parsley, pecorino cheese and salt on top of the meat slices.
Roll up the meat slices and close them with toothpicks.
Finish rolling and securing the meat rolls with toothpicks.
Put the olive oil in a pan and sauté the sliced onion.
Add the meat rolls to the pan with the sautéed onion.
Continue browning the meat rolls with the onion in the pan.
Add the tomato passata to the pan.
Let the cutlets cook in the tomato sauce until done.
Final cooking: the horsemeat cutlets simmered in tomato sauce, ready to be served.

healthBenefits.title: Lean, Iron-Rich Meat
healthBenefits.text: Horsemeat is naturally lean and exceptionally rich in iron and vitamin B12, supporting healthy red blood cell production and energy metabolism.

healthBenefits.title: Calcium from Pecorino
healthBenefits.text: Pecorino cheese provides a good source of calcium and protein, contributing to bone health and muscle maintenance.

healthBenefits.title: Antioxidant Tomato Puree
healthBenefits.text: Tomato puree is rich in lycopene, a powerful antioxidant linked to reduced risk of heart disease and certain cancers.

healthBenefits.title: Immune-Supporting Garlic
healthBenefits.text: Garlic contains allicin, known for its antimicrobial and cardiovascular benefits, including modest blood pressure reduction.

healthBenefits.title: Parsley's Vitamin Boost
healthBenefits.text: Fresh parsley adds vitamin K and vitamin C, supporting bone health and immune function.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Olive Oil
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil provides monounsaturated fats that help maintain healthy cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation.

_ingredientsText:
4 slices of horsemeat
100 gr of pecorino cheese, grated
 2 sprigs of parsley
 3 cloves of garlic, chopped
 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
 700 gr of tomato puree
 1 onion, sliced
 salt
_preparationText:
1 -  2  Lay the slices of horsemeat on a cutting board and on top of the meat place: the garlic, parsley, pecorino cheese, salt and, if desired, a little chili or pepper.
3 - 4 Roll them up and close them with toothpicks.
5 - 7 Put the olive oil in a pan and sauté the sliced onion. Then add the meat rolls.
8 add  tomato passata
9 cottura finale
